crossRefs.note: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

translations.web: On the seventh day, some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.
translations.bsb: Yet on the seventh day some of the people went out to gather, but they did not find anything.
